protocol.name: snowleopard_window_server_v1

description.summary: the window server's private calls, for the shell

protocol.description:
What the Dock, SystemUIServer, the Finder, loginwindow and screencapture ask the Mac's window server through CoreGraphics' private CGS calls (CGSGetWindowList, CGSOrderWindow, CGSSetSymbolicHotKey, CGSHWCaptureWindowList, CGSSetMagicMirror...), here between the shell's programs and the Wayland WindowServer. The X11 session has the same through properties of the root window (_NET_CLIENT_LIST, _SNOWLEOPARD_FRONT_APP, _SNOWLEOPARD_HOTKEY...).
Windows are named by a number of the server's, never 0, the same on every connection: the applications' windows (xdg toplevels and Xwayland's), not the shell's layers or menus.

interface.name: sl_window_server_v1

description.summary: the window server

interface.description: Bound, it sends every window (window), their order, the active one, the work area and the application in front, then done; afterwards each change, then done.

entry.name: hidden
entry.summary: hidden by Hide (⌘H): not in the Dock

entry.name: dialog
entry.summary: a dialog or a sheet (it has a parent)

entry.name: skip_taskbar
entry.summary: not one of the application's windows for the Dock

description.summary: the window brought forward and made key (unminimized, shown)
the application asked to close it (xdg_toplevel.close, WM_DELETE_WINDOW)
Hide (⌘H): out of sight, without a tile in the Dock
where the Dock shows the window (its tile), for the genie

request.name: set_front_app

description.summary: this application in front without a window

request.description: A Mac application keeps the menu bar with no window open: this connection's application (pid) is in front until a window is activated or it asks again with 0. While it is, the keys go to it (key event) when no window has the keyboard.

request.name: register_hot_keys

description.summary: CGSSetSymbolicHotKey: the symbolic hot keys this connection answers

request.description: 28 ⇧⌘3, 29 ⌃⇧⌘3, 30 ⇧⌘4, 31 ⌃⇧⌘4 (an array of uint32): the server takes them and sends hot_key.

request.name: set_key_equivalents

description.summary: the Command keys this application's menus answer

request.description: Keysyms (an array of uint32) that WindowServer then leaves to this connection's application with Command (⌘W, ⌘Q, ⌘M, ⌘H...), as the X11 server reads _SNOWLEOPARD_KEY_EQUIVALENTS.

request.name: set_magic_mirror

description.summary: CGSSetMagicMirror: what is beside a layer, drawn turned over under it

request.description: For the layer surface whose namespace is `layer` (the Dock's): direction 1 bottom, 2 top, 3 left, 4 right, 0 none; the quadrangle (four points, x then y, int32) in the layer's coordinates.

request.name: capture_window

description.summary: CGSHWCaptureWindowList: a window's picture
the screen as it is drawn, this rectangle of it, as a PNG to fd

request.name: pick_window

description.summary: the window at this point of the screen (screencapture's window mode)

request.description: The capture's done event says which (its x: the window, 0 for none).

event.name: window

description.summary: a window, new or changed

event.description: Its frame (title bar included) on the screen, the application's pid and app_id (X11: WM_CLASS's class), its title, the flags, and the D-Bus menu of the application (the org_kde_kwin_appmenu or _KDE_NET_WM_APPMENU address, empty when none).

description.summary: the windows, bottom to top (an array of uint32)
the key window, 0 when none (the desktop, a shell layer)

event.name: front_app

description.summary: the application in front without a window (set_front_app), pid 0 for none

event.description: The serial changes each time one asks, so that the menu bar can tell a new request from an old one.

description.summary: the screen less the menu bar and the Dock (their exclusive zones)
a symbolic hot key this connection registered was pressed

event.name: key

description.summary: a key for the application in front without a window

event.description: Pressed while this connection's set_front_app holds and no window has the keyboard: the keysym, the text it types, the modifiers (1 shift, 4 control, 8 alt, 64 command).

description.summary: the changes sent so far are a whole

event.name: done

description.summary: the capture's result

event.description: ok 1 when the PNG was written; x and y: where the window's frame is in the picture (the shadow's room), or the window picked.
